verdict.rationale: The evidence covers pull request review and merging, Gitea Actions CI/CD, and general permission and access-control features. None of it documents branch protection, required status checks, or any way to block a merge until custom quality or compliance checks pass. Actions workflows and webhooks are building blocks for running checks, not documented merge-gate enforcement, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enforce custom quality and compliance merge checks on pull requests
